channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: When my grandfather turned 65 he started walking 5 miles a day..
item.description:
When my grandfather turned 65 he started walking 5 miles a day..
He's 90 now and we have no idea where he is.

item.title: I was reading in the paper today about this dwarf that got pick-pocketed.
item.description:
I was reading in the paper today about this dwarf that got pick-pocketed.
How could anyone stoop so low?

item.title: What do you call two monkeys sharing an Amazon account?
item.description:
What do you call two monkeys sharing an Amazon account?
Prime-mates.

item.title: Did you hear about the guy who swallowed a lamp?
item.description:
Did you hear about the guy who swallowed a lamp?
He just wanted a light snack.

item.title: My fathers advice: "if you got up there on your own you can get down on your own".
item.description:
My fathers advice: "if you got up there on your own you can get down on your own".
Great father. Awful air traffic controller.

item.title: How did they decide on a name for Canada?
item.description:
How did they decide on a name for Canada?
“Well there should be C, eh?” “And an N, eh?” “And a D, eh?

item.title: My wife keeps blowing everything out of proportion.
item.description:
My wife keeps blowing everything out of proportion.
She is single-handedly ruining my balloon animal business.

item.title: I've been diagnosed with a fear of giants
item.description:
I've been diagnosed with a fear of giants
Feefiphobia

item.title: "What's up, dad?"
item.description:
"What's up, dad?"
"It's a movie about an old man and balloons, son".

item.title: "Is this gluten free?"
item.description:
"Is this gluten free?"
"No, it costs money, sir."
